stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Michael Castle holding 41 pts - top of the table like the Dolphins, young comp, old head

stories.title: Not Our Problem
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 5 & 11 - the course just surrendered

stories.title: Runaway
stories.detail: 5 clear at the top - daylight second

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 210 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 5 off the pace

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Gary Brown up 16 spots - like the Crows: quiet all day, lethal late

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome aboard, Ian Menz - the club is glad to host Gundagai District Services GC today. Enjoy every hole.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 4 marker sitting 8th

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 15 & 16

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 20, back nine 13 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Turn for the Better
stories.detail: Caught fire at the turn - 9 across 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 3 threes and 3 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 17 & 18 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 5, 1-pointer on hole 6

stories.title: High Low Express
stories.detail: From 4-pointer to wipe in one hole - nobody does it like this

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 8 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Squeaky Clean
stories.detail: Zero wipes from 14 holes - not a wipe in sight

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 1-4 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Nothing But Ones
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers, zero wipes - zero wipes is something to hang your hat on

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 6 straight two-pointers on holes 8-13
